simpleloot.title: Simple Loot
text.autoconfig.simpleloot.option.enable:
Allow repeat vault rewards after the server
cooldown. Disable to retain Vanilla one-time
rewards. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleloot.option.vaultC:
Time in Minecraft days until a player can
loot a vault again. Default: 100. Allowed
range: 1–36500.
simpleloot.guide.page.1.title: Simple Loot
simpleloot.guide.page.1: Vault rewards come back after a cooldown in days instead of once per player. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simpleloot.guide.page.2.title: Vault cooldown
simpleloot.guide.page.2: A player may loot a vault again after vaultCooldownDays, default 100 Minecraft days, bounded 1–36500. The original SimpleBuildingLootTimes UUID-to-time map is retained.
simpleloot.guide.page.3.title: Vault cooldown
simpleloot.guide.page.3: Missing timestamps on already rewarded entries start a cooldown rather than granting free repeat loot; backwards time does not unlock rewards.
simpleloot.guide.page.4.title: Commands
simpleloot.guide.page.4: Permission level 2: /simpleloot vaults cooldown <days> and /simpleloot vaults repeat <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpleloot.json.
simpleloot.guide.page.5.title: Commands
simpleloot.guide.page.5: /simpleloot config shows and changes every option of config/simpleloot.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once.
simpleloot.guide.page.6.title: Commands
simpleloot.guide.page.7.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleloot.guide.page.7: Playable alone (config/simpleloot.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Loot".
simpleloot.guide.page.8.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleloot.guide.page.8: On the first start the old Simple QoL settings of this sub-mod are taken over once.
simpleloot.guide.page.9.title: Settings
simpleloot.guide.page.9: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
